evidenceNotes.observation: The pinned diff from 0cfb9ad1c3a4ea5983c8dbb458ed14f7581a6846 to b239497ecacac5e5c945791530251f1ee897b22b is byte-identical to the 6,496-byte stored artifact (SHA-256 a558a94c131a9176bbf4ab728c9a5b02abae12ab56f364c52489e75ad7da2c94); merge base, trees 6f44b1c65a56b58a8ac7c4819d0cab2d5088c143 and 3f3fb544cd8cbe32db074e07f56b2c9bf54f632f, and 4-file +60/-3 stats match.

The server exit callback calls serviceExited(!isRestarting), whose restart=true path starts a replacement service, and then deletes the memoized extension-wide root used by getTempFile. This makes the wrong-lifecycle cleanup reachable during automatic restart and can remove live cancellation/temp state.

The authenticated review comment identifies restart breakage at the original defect-bearing commit; the correction removes cleanup from service exit, adds deactivation cleanup, and introduces an instance directory, corroborating the minimal lifetime boundary without treating the comment alone as proof.

The case is MIT-licensed and explicitly limits its claim to cleanup at the service-process rather than extension-instance lifecycle boundary; it discloses that the historical toolchain was not executed and makes no repository-wide clean claim.
